import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lookback_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    lookback_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    lookback_365 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]

    # Только заказы, существующие на момент seed_time
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    relevant_items = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    items_full = relevant_items.merge(
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    items_historic = items_full[items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    def agg_window(items, suffix):
        if len(items) == 0:
            return pd.DataFrame({"product_id": []})
        return items.groupby("product_id").agg(
            **{
                f"units_sold_{suffix}": ("order_item_id", "count"),
                f"revenue_{suffix}": ("price", "sum"),
                f"avg_price_{suffix}": ("price", "mean"),
                f"total_freight_{suffix}": ("freight_value", "sum"),
                f"unique_orders_{suffix}": ("order_id", "nunique"),
                f"unique_sellers_{suffix}": ("seller_id", "nunique"),
            }
        ).reset_index()

    items_90 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_90]
    items_180 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_180]
    items_365 = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > lookback_365]

    agg_90 = agg_window(items_90, "90")
    agg_180 = agg_window(items_180, "180")
    agg_365 = agg_window(items_365, "365")

    # Recency
    if len(items_historic):
        last_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
        recency = (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days.rename("recency_days").reset_index()
        first_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].min()
        age = (seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days.rename("age_days").reset_index()
    else:
        recency = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": [], "recency_days": []})
        age = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": [], "age_days": []})

    # Отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже созданы к моменту seed_time
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    reviews_hist = reviews_hist[["order_id", "review_score"]].drop_duplicates(subset="order_id")
    items_reviews = items_historic[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        reviews_hist, on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    review_agg = items_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        bad_reviews=("review_score", lambda s: (s <= 2).sum()),
    ).reset_index()

    final_features = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)})

    for df in [agg_90, agg_180, agg_365, recency, age, review_agg]:
        final_features = final_features.merge(df, on="product_id", how="left")

    # Производные признаки
    eps = 1e-9
    final_features["sales_velocity_90"] = final_features["units_sold_90"] / 90.0
    final_features["trend_90_180"] = (
        final_features["units_sold_90"] / 90.0
        - (final_features["units_sold_180"] - final_features["units_sold_90"]) / 90.0
    )
    final_features["rev_per_order_90"] = final_features["revenue_90"] / (
        final_features["unique_orders_90"] + eps
    )
    final_features["bad_review_ratio"] = final_features["bad_reviews"] / (
        final_features["total_reviews"] + eps
    )

    fill_zero_cols = [
        "units_sold_90", "revenue_90", "avg_price_90", "total_freight_90",
        "unique_orders_90", "unique_sellers_90",
        "units_sold_180", "revenue_180", "avg_price_180", "total_freight_180",
        "unique_orders_180", "unique_sellers_180",
        "units_sold_365", "revenue_365", "avg_price_365", "total_freight_365",
        "unique_orders_365", "unique_sellers_365",
        "avg_review", "total_reviews", "bad_reviews",
        "sales_velocity_90", "trend_90_180", "rev_per_order_90", "bad_review_ratio",
    ]
    for col in fill_zero_cols:
        if col in final_features.columns:
            final_features[col] = final_features[col].fillna(0)

    final_features["recency_days"] = final_features["recency_days"].fillna(365)
    final_features["age_days"] = final_features["age_days"].fillna(0)

    final_features = final_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0).astype(float)

    return final_features
